title: Predicting the Compressive Strength of Sustainable Portland Cement-Fly Ash Mortar Using Explainable Boosting Machine Learning Techniques.
summary: 395 literature-derived mortar observations modeled using GBR/LGBM/AdaBoost; GBR was strongest and SHAP identified curing time and fly-ash chemistry. GBR 10-fold mean R² 0.941. Computational material-strength model, not new mortar formulation. AI role: Gradient boosting regressor (GBR), LightGBM, AdaBoost and SHAP. The article appeared in Materials (Basel, Switzerland).
